stepsLanded.name: bounds self-description
stepsLanded.detail: JevTelemetry gained boundsKind and boundsCount, set at every bounds return site (questions, question-bytes, batches, pairs, candidates, windows, window-bytes) and mapped through citedBoundsTelemetry; the cited-evidence helper return types were widened.

stepsLanded.name: bounds triggers repair
stepsLanded.detail: repairTriggersSemantics(reason) returns true for uncertain, unsupported and bounds; the repair instruction names the bounds kind and size and asks for fewer candidates with one shortest exact quotation each. Availability and privacy refusals stay excluded on purpose.
stepsLanded.test: test_bounds_and_semantic_holds_trigger_repair_but_refusals_do_not, written after the helper so it is a regression test rather than a RED, plus the live arm below

findingFromStep1.statement: The per-question byte bound is the binding constraint, and the evidence window cap of eight can never bind.
findingFromStep1.evidence: Citing 120 small entries makes every window question exceed 64 KB, because the full cited support set rides in each question, so the refusal is question-bytes before any window count is evaluated. The test records this rather than asserting it away.
findingFromStep1.consequence: Step 4 must shrink the request (do not repeat the full cited support in every question), not the window count.

weakGeneratorComparison.generator: cli-proxy/doubao-seed-2-0-mini-260428, pluggy, decoy level L2, literal constraint

onBefore.memory: proposed, 0 operations, Jev propose: bounds, no request issued

onAfter.memory: APPLIED, 2 operations, Jev decided: supported, 8 of 8 requests completed
onAfter.enforcement: side effect present, harness plan noop

weakGeneratorComparison.reading: On a weak generator the Memory path recovered from 0 to 2 operations with a genuine supported judgment and no bounds refusal. The remaining failures are generation coverage rather than judgment: the plan contained only two candidates and omitted the verified project command, and the harness plan was empty. No gate can restore an item the generator never proposed.

attributionCaveat.statement: The weak-generator 0 to 2 operation difference between the off and on arms CANNOT be attributed to Jev's judgment.
attributionCaveat.reason: The weak generator is nondeterministic and produced different plans: the off arm's plan was rejected twice by the parent's structural checks, while the on arm's plan passed with two valid candidates. Two different inputs cannot isolate the judge.
attributionCaveat.whatWouldIsolateIt: Inject one fixed plan through both paths, Jev off and Jev on, and count what lands. The frozen corpus already shows the on path holds 10 of 10 negatives with 0 false allows; the missing control is what the off path does with the same fixed plan. Without that control the honest claim is only that the off path has no semantic gate at all.

regressionReference.result: 14 of 14 matched, 0 false allows, 0 false holds, 14 requests
regressionReference.reading: The bounds diagnostics and the bounds-as-repair-trigger did not regress Jev's judgment on the frozen corpus.

nextWork: Controlled plan injection: one fixed plan through the Jev-off and Jev-on paths, counting what lands, which is the only way to attribute a difference to the judge.

Coverage repair for Memory: when the dossier holds a verified tool result for the task command but no candidate cites it, trigger the existing repair with a coverage instruction, and record whether the weak on arm then satisfies safeFact.
Coverage repair for Harness: when the evidence states a durable prohibition but the plan is empty, trigger the harness repair instead of accepting noop.
Step 4: shrink the request so the full cited support set is not repeated in every question.
limits: One weak generator and one project; the weak model is nondeterministic, as its plan shape differed between runs.
The on arm still fails overall, so the pre-registered target is only partly met: operations met, safeFact not met.
No arm was rerun except with changed code, and every failure record is preserved.
